availability_overrides_hours_check.name: availability_overrides_hours_check
availability_overrides_hours_check.value: "availability_overrides"."is_closed" or ("availability_overrides"."start_time" is not null and "availability_overrides"."end_time" is not null and "availability_overrides"."end_time" > "availability_overrides"."start_time")

booking_requests_when_check.name: booking_requests_when_check
booking_requests_when_check.value: ("booking_requests"."type" = 'date' AND "booking_requests"."slot_date" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_requests"."starts_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("booking_requests"."type" = 'due_date' AND "booking_requests"."due_date" IS NOT NULL)

photo_extras_settings_prices_check.name: photo_extras_settings_prices_check
photo_extras_settings_prices_check.value: "photo_extras_settings"."extra_photo_cents" between 100 and 100000 and "photo_extras_settings"."full_gallery_cents" between 100 and 1000000 and "photo_extras_settings"."raw_files_cents" between 100 and 1000000

photo_extras_settings_delivery_check.name: photo_extras_settings_delivery_check
photo_extras_settings_delivery_check.value: "photo_extras_settings"."extras_delivery_hours" between 1 and 720 and "photo_extras_settings"."full_delivery_days" between 1 and 90 and "photo_extras_settings"."raw_delivery_hours" between 1 and 720

shoot_inspo_content_check.name: shoot_inspo_content_check
shoot_inspo_content_check.value: ("shoot_inspo"."type" in ('image', 'video') and "shoot_inspo"."blob_url" is not null and "shoot_inspo"."blob_pathname" is not null) or ("shoot_inspo"."type" = 'link' and "shoot_inspo"."link_url" is not null) or "shoot_inspo"."type" = 'note'

shoots_kind_fields_check.name: shoots_kind_fields_check
shoots_kind_fields_check.value: ("shoots"."kind" = 'booking' and "shoots"."booking_id" is not null) or ("shoots"."kind" = 'styled' and "shoots"."booking_id" is null and "shoots"."date" is not null)
